entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Two-Party Democracy and Garment Boom, a transformative movement in Bangladesh (1991–2009). Emerged from Sheikh Hasina's Awami League. Catalyzed Rana Plaza garment factory collapse kills over 1,100 workers and Myanmar's Rohingya crisis sends over 700,000 refugees to Bangladesh.
